description: Defines the 'ue_link_adaptation_controller' class responsible for link adaptation in a UE, including MCS derivation, handling DL/UL feedback, and managing OLLA algorithms.

classes.name: ue_link_adaptation_controller
classes.description: Manages link adaptation for a UE, including MCS calculation, feedback handling, and OLLA algorithm management.

methods.name: ue_link_adaptation_controller
methods.description: Constructor initializing with cell configuration and UE channel state.

methods.name: handle_dl_ack_info
methods.description: Updates DL link quality based on HARQ feedback.

methods.name: handle_ul_crc_info
methods.description: Updates UL link quality based on CRC feedback.

methods.name: calculate_dl_mcs
methods.description: Calculates appropriate DL MCS based on CQI and BLER.

methods.name: calculate_ul_mcs
methods.description: Calculates UL MCS based on estimated SNR and BLER.

methods.name: dl_cqi_offset
methods.description: Returns current DL CQI offset used by OLLA.

methods.name: ul_snr_offset_db
methods.description: Returns current UL SNR offset used by OLLA.

methods.name: is_dl_olla_enabled
methods.description: Checks if DL OLLA is enabled.

methods.name: is_ul_olla_enabled
methods.description: Checks if UL OLLA is enabled.

methods.name: get_effective_cqi
methods.description: Returns effective CQI considering offsets for MCS derivation.

methods.name: get_effective_snr
methods.description: Calculates effective UL SNR after applying offset.

methods.name: update_dl_mcs_lims
methods.description: Updates DL MCS boundaries based on selected MCS table.

methods.name: update_ul_mcs_lims
methods.description: Updates UL MCS boundaries based on selected MCS table and transform precoder flag.
